blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate finance committee chairman Jose Victor “JV” Ejercito said that the Senate will open the bicameral conference committee to the civil society organizations (CSOs) for a more transparent 2027 General Appropriations Bill (GAB). The Senate will resume its plenary sessions on Nov. 9, where the senators will deliberate the P7.2 trillion budget bill for next year. Ejercito said that apart from livestreaming the hearings, they invited business coalitions, civic groups, and watchdogs to help the Senate scrutinize the House-approved version of the 2027 GAB. “We are continuing to build on our best practices.
